result:
In `pricebook.py`, 14 rules didn't match their docstrings, and I fixed all of them. Afterwards I checked all 150 rules: a script turned each docstring into a reference calculation and compared it with the actual function over many quantity and unit price values. No rule differs anymore.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 04, 06, 125 | Used `round()`, but discounts must be rounded down to the won | `// 100` |
| 35, 130 | Capped the base price instead of the discount | Calculate the discount, then `min(disc, 30000)` |
| 51, 65 | Cap only applied once the discount went over 200,000 | Always `min(disc, 100000)` |
| 52, 134 | Threshold check was `qty > 100` | `qty >= 100` |
| 74 | Rate was 16% | 15% |
| 141 | Rate was 4% | 3% |
| 107 | Labelled whole but only discounted units above the threshold | Discount on `base` (all units) |

STATUS: DONE
